rule.name: SpringNullOnlyConfigCheck
rule.message: Use StringUtils.hasText (or hasLength, or isBlank next to the null test) to test this configuration string, not only a null check. A property set to an empty value binds as an empty string, which passes a null check, so the feature turns on with nothing to use; requireNonNullElse, Optional.orElse and Environment.containsProperty count the empty value as set too. An exception fits only when an empty value is a real setting here.

property.name: xpath
